name: Populace reform-validation registry (per-release external checks)
organization: PolicyEngine (aggregating JCT, CBO, Census, IRS SOI, Treasury, state fiscal offices, state agencies)
data_url: vendored from calibration-diagnostics frontend/lib/populace/reform-overrides/ (the retired External checks tab)
fetch_notes: Each raw/<release_id>.json is the reform_validation.json artifact for one certified populace-us release, produced by populace's reform_validation_payload at the release's exact policyengine-us/-core pins (provenance in each file's _backfill_note, and a structured engine block on artifacts produced here). New releases arrive from the Modal-backed backfill re-homed from cal-diag #112 into tools/reform_validation/ (.github/workflows/reform-validation-backfill.yml): the sim runs on Modal, register_release.py lands the artifact, and scorecard_db.ingest_reform_validation rebuilds the DB slice.

model.name: external scorekeepers + admin actuals (mixed)
model.method: Registry of external checks scored against each release: JCT conventional scores (OBBBA suite, ARPA), CBO budget options, JCT/Treasury tax expenditures, IRS SOI and EITC Central actuals, Census state SPM rates, state fiscal notes (KS/CT/ID/CO/GA/IA/MD/MI/ND/OK/CA), state agency program actuals, and one mechanical UBI check vs Census PEP. The PE value is computed at the release's own engine pins, so results form a per-release regression history.

diagnosis_upstream: Registry specs live in PolicyEngine/populace — spec errors become populace PRs; benchmark errors become annotation updates here.
